ValidationRule.description: Prevent Change in primary customer field section in approved status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) = 'Approved' , OR ( ISCHANGED( CLA_Account__c ) , ISCHANGED( CLA_VFS_Customer_Number__c ) , ISCHANGED( CLA_Primary_Customer_Name__c ), ISCHANGED( CLA_Company_Identification_Number__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Primary Customer section can not be edited.
